lead: Meat and poultry products a household buys, by animal (beef, pork, lamb and goat, poultry, game, other meats) and then by preserved form (cured hams and whole muscles, sausages by tradition, deli and tinned meats), with cuts under their regional names and graded, breed and protected-origin products as archetypes.

b.v: protected origin (PDO/PGI, Japanese brand wagyu) > named breed > generic
b.w: Protected names and breed registries are the main premium filters across meat; breeds link to the animal breeds register.
Grass-fed, grain-finished, free-range, organic and acorn-fed (bellota) claims; label claims, not grades.
Dry-ageing for beef and game, cure time for hams; longer is dearer, not always better.

depts.note: Tier for everyday cuts (named by regional cut chart), variety for graded, breed and branded beef.

b.v: Prime > Choice > Select > Standard > Commercial > Utility > Cutter > Canner
b.w: US grade from marbling and maturity.
JMGA yield letter and quality number; A5 needs BMS 8-12.

b.v: MSA graded with marbling score; non-MSA
b.w: Meat Standards Australia predicts eating quality per cut and cooking method.
Dry-ageing concentrates flavour and tenderises; sold by days aged.
Grass-fed, grain-finished and pasture-raised are the first premium filters.

s.brief: Variety shelf; archetype standard (archetype = named brand beef or protected origin; versions = grades/producers; detail = BMS, cut, ageing). Japanese wagyu: originators first: Kobe (Kobe Beef Marketing & Distribution Promotion Association, Tajima cattle, A4/A5 BMS 6+), Matsusaka, Omi (the 'three great wagyu'), then Miyazaki, Kagoshima, Hida, Yonezawa, Ozaki, Olive wagyu; note the four wagyu breeds (Japanese Black, Brown, Shorthorn, Polled). Wagyu outside Japan: Australian wagyu (MSA marbling, fullblood vs crossbred F1-F4; notable producers only if sourced), American wagyu (e.g. Snake River Farms), Hanwoo (Korea). Breed-branded beef: Certified Angus Beef (first breed brand, 1978), Hereford, Aberdeen Angus, Highland, Longhorn, Galician Blond/Rubia Gallega, Chianina, Charolais, Limousin. Protected-origin beef (EU/UK PDO/PGI): Scotch Beef PGI, Welsh Beef PGI, Irish Grass Fed Beef PGI, Ternera Gallega PGI, Vitellone Bianco dell'Appennino Centrale PGI, Boeuf de Charolles PDO, Fin Gras du Mezenc PDO. Dry-aged beef: kind-level with types (dry-aged on bone, in tallow, aged ex-dairy/old cow 'vaca vieja') and no SKU lists. Link breeds to the breeds register (C3 living animals).

k.brief: Kobe, Matsusaka, Omi first; JMGA grade and BMS as detail axes.
Australian, American, crossbred grades (F1-F4, fullblood).
Certified Angus Beef and breed-society schemes; Hanwoo.
PDO/PGI beef as archetypes.

Ibérico pork (fresh): named cuts secreto, presa, pluma, lagarto, abanico as types; label classes (bellota/cebo de campo/cebo) as detail. Heritage-breed pork: Berkshire/Kurobuta, Kagoshima Kurobuta, Mangalitsa, Duroc, Gloucestershire Old Spot, Tamworth, Large Black, Cinta Senese PDO, Noir de Bigorre PDO; Jinhua. Suckling pig: Cochinillo de Segovia (marca de garantía), lechón; trim to sourced items.

s.brief: Variety shelf. Salt-marsh lamb: Pré-salé du Mont-Saint-Michel PDO, Prés-salés de la baie de Somme PDO, Gower salt marsh lamb. Protected & breed lamb: Welsh Lamb PGI, Lakeland Herdwick PDO, Shetland Lamb PDO, Orkney Lamb PDO, Agneau de Sisteron PGI, Agneau de Pauillac PGI, New Zealand lamb, Texel/Suffolk crosses only if sourced. Suckling lamb: Lechazo de Castilla y León PGI, Abbacchio Romano PGI, Cordero Manchego; kids (cabrito) go to Goat. Mutton & hogget: the old catch-all 'Lamb' kind, reduced to mutton/hogget and whole or half lamb as types; Mutton Renaissance-type schemes only if sourced.

k.brief: Dissolve catch-all; types: mutton, hogget, whole lamb, half lamb.

depts.note: Tier for cuts, variety for protected and heritage birds and foie gras.

b.v: organic > free-range (Label Rouge / traditional free range) > free-range > barn/indoor
b.w: EU marketing standards define the farming terms; Label Rouge adds slower-growing breeds and age at slaughter.
Slow-growing and heritage breeds, capons and poulardes are the premium end.
Certified Humane, GAP, RSPCA Assured and no-antibiotics claims are buyer signals.

s.brief: Archetypes on Whole chicken: Poulet de Bresse PDO (originator of protected poultry; versions poulet, poularde, chapon), Label Rouge fermier (versions Landes, Loué), Ixworth/heritage breeds, corn-fed, poussin and capon as types. Trim the D'Artagnan Green Circle range repeated on two kinds to one brand-register entry. Cuts stay tier: breast (types supreme, fillet, mini fillets), leg (thigh, drumstick, leg quarter), wings (whole, flats, drumettes). Poultry mince & burgers: chicken, turkey, duck mince as types.

k.brief: Types: chicken, turkey, duck.

s.brief: Turkey: Norfolk Black, Kelly Bronze (British bronze), US heritage breeds (Bourbon Red, Narragansett), Dinde de Bresse; types whole, crown, breast, thigh roast. Whole duck: Pekin/Long Island, Aylesbury, Gressingham, Barbary/Muscovy, Challans (canard de Challans), Moulard; duck breast: magret (from foie gras ducks) vs Pekin breast. Goose: Embden, Toulouse, Christmas goose. Foie gras: IGP Canard à foie gras du Sud-Ouest; grades extra/A/B as ladder; makers Rougié, Hudson Valley Foie Gras (brand register); duck vs goose as versions; prepared foie gras (mi-cuit, bloc) belongs to the deli shelf.

depts.note: Organised by animal; species, wild vs farmed and season are the axes.

b.w: Wild game varies by season and shot; farmed game is milder and year-round.
Legal shooting seasons set availability; hanging time develops flavour.

s.brief: The old 'Venison (any cut)' catch-all becomes the species kind: archetypes red deer, roe deer, fallow deer, sika, muntjac, reindeer, elk/moose, New Zealand farmed venison (Cervena appellation), Scottish wild venison schemes; species as archetypes, cut as detail. Merge saddle and medallions; merge mince and burgers.

k.brief: Types: saddle on the bone, loin, medallions.

s.brief: Species kinds with season and wild/farmed as detail; red grouse (Glorious Twelfth), black grouse, ptarmigan as grouse versions; grey vs red-legged partridge; mallard, teal, wigeon for wild duck; wood pigeon vs farmed squab (pigeonneau) split into types; Japanese vs European quail; guinea fowl (pintade, Label Rouge) is farmed. Add woodcock and snipe only if sourced as sold.
Merge rabbit cuts into one kind with types (whole, saddle, legs; wild vs farmed). Hare: brown vs mountain hare. Wild boar: wild vs farmed, species notes. Squirrel (grey squirrel, UK).

k.brief: Types: whole, jointed, saddle, legs.

depts.note: Organised by product family, protected names and makers as archetypes.

b.v: Black (100% ibérico de bellota) > Red (ibérico de bellota) > Green (cebo de campo) > White (cebo)
b.w: Spanish quality norm (RD 4/2014) seals; pata negra only black.
Minimum cure times are part of PDO and label rules.
PDO/PGI names (Parma, San Daniele, Guijuelo, Jabugo, Bayonne, Speck Alto Adige) fix region, breed and method; unranked.

s.brief: Variety shelf; archetype = protected name or house. Jamón ibérico: PDOs Guijuelo, Jabugo, Dehesa de Extremadura, Los Pedroches as archetypes; the four label classes as versions/detail; houses Cinco Jotas, Joselito, Sánchez Romero Carvajal into the brand register. Prosciutto crudo: Prosciutto di Parma PDO (originator), Prosciutto di San Daniele PDO, Toscano PDO, Prosciutto di Carpegna, Culatello di Zibello PDO (move from the old ham kind). Jamón serrano: Jamón de Teruel PDO, Jamón de Trevélez PGI, Serrano TSG. Regional dry-cured hams (old general kind): Jambon de Bayonne PGI, Carmarthen Ham, Kraški pršut, Presunto de Barrancos, Jinhua ham, American country ham (Smithfield/Virginia); redistribute its Parma/San Daniele/Culatello models to Prosciutto and Speck to Smoked raw ham. Smoked raw ham: Speck Alto Adige PGI, Schwarzwälder Schinken (Black Forest ham) PGI, Westfälischer Knochenschinken, Ammerländer. Paleta: ibérico shoulder ladder mirrors jamón.

Archetypes from protected names: Coppa Piacentina PDO, Capocollo di Calabria PDO, Coppa di Parma PGI; Lomo embuchado (ibérico); Bresaola della Valtellina PGI, Cecina de León PGI, Bündnerfleisch PGI, pastırma; Guanciale (Amatriciana tradition); Lardo di Colonnata PGI, Vallée d'Aoste Lard d'Arnad PDO, salo; Pancetta Piacentina PDO, pancetta tesa vs arrotolata.

Bacon archetypes by cure: Wiltshire cure, Ayrshire bacon, American streaky (dry-cured, e.g. Benton's only if sourced), Canadian peameal back bacon; types streaky, back, middle, smoked/unsmoked. Gammon: types joint, steak; York ham cure. Cooked ham archetypes: York ham, Prague ham (Pražská šunka), Jambon de Paris, Prosciutto cotto, Bradenham, Wiltshire, Brunswick, jambon torchon (existing models become archetypes/versions). Corned beef / salt beef and pastrami: New York deli and Montreal smoked meat as archetypes; keep Zingerman's only as brand-register entry. Cooked tongue stays kind-level.

Split dried meats by tradition: Jerky (American; types beef, turkey, game), Biltong & droëwors (South Africa), Bakkwa (Chinese/Singaporean sweet dried meat), Charqui/carne seca only if sourced. Pickled or fermented meat: nem chua, pickled pork, sour fermented meats; keep a few sourced archetypes.

depts.note: Organised by method (fresh, cooked/smoked, dry-cured) and within each by tradition.

b.w: Meat percentage, casing (natural vs collagen) and organic (Bio) are the main quality filters; protected names fix recipe and region.
PGI/PDO sausages (Cumberland, Nürnberger, Thüringer, Mortadella Bologna, Kabanos, Stornoway black pudding) fix recipe and region.

s.brief: Sausages to cook, by tradition. British sausage (old 'Other fresh sausage'): Cumberland PGI, Lincolnshire, Oxford, chipolata, bangers; move luganega to Italian sausage. Bratwurst: Nürnberger Rostbratwurst PGI, Thüringer Rostbratwurst PGI, Coburger. Italian sausage: salsiccia, luganega, US sweet/hot Italian. Breakfast sausage: US links/patties (maple, sage). Toulouse sausage. Merguez. Boerewors. Fresh chorizo & longaniza (Mexican chorizo, longaniza). Keep brands in the register only.

By tradition. Frankfurter & hot dog: Frankfurter Würstchen, Wiener, knackwurst, US hot dog (all-beef/kosher). Kielbasa: Polish kiełbasa types (krakowska, wiejska, myśliwska), Kabanos PGI goes to dry sausages, US smoked sausage, Cajun andouille. Weisswurst (Münchner). Cervelat (Swiss national sausage; move from the salami models). Mortadella & bologna: Mortadella Bologna PGI, US bologna, Lyoner, Jagdwurst. Liver sausage: Braunschweiger, Pfälzer Leberwurst, Teewurst only if liver-free note. Black pudding: Stornoway PGI, Bury, morcilla de Burgos, boudin noir, Blutwurst. White pudding: Irish (Clonakilty), Scottish mealie pudding, boudin blanc. Andouillette (AAAAA) only if sourced.

Split the old 11-model salami kind by tradition. Italian salame: Genoa, Milano, Salame Felino PGI, Salame di Varzi PDO, Finocchiona PGI, Soppressata, Salame Cacciatore PDO, Salame Napoli. Saucisson sec: Rosette de Lyon, Saucisson de l'Ardèche PGI, Jésus. Fuet & salchichón: fuet, Salchichón de Vic PGI, Llonganissa. Hungarian winter salami (Pick, Herz in brand register; Szegedi szalámi PDO). Chorizo: Chorizo de Cantimpalos PGI, Chorizo Riojano PGI; ibérico chorizo. 'Nduja & sobrasada: 'Nduja di Spilinga, Sobrasada de Mallorca PGI. Pepperoni. Sucuk (Turkish/Balkan). Chinese sausage (lap cheong, Cantonese vs Sichuan). Kabanos & snack sticks: Kabanos PGI, Landjäger, cabanossi, US meat sticks. Droëwors goes to Biltong (cured shelf); Cervelat to cooked sausages.

depts.note: Variety for French charcuterie (pâtés, rillettes, confit), tier for everyday cooked and tinned meats.

s.brief: Pâtés and terrines has no source yet: source it. Archetypes: pâté de campagne, pâté en croûte, Ardennes pâté, Brussels pâté, jambon persillé (Burgundy), pâté Hénaff (brand register). Rillettes: Rillettes de Tours PGI, rillettes du Mans, duck/goose rillettes. Prepared foie gras: entier, bloc, mi-cuit, torchon, mousse as versions (French labelling rules), makers in the brand register. Confit: confit de canard (Gascony/Sud-Ouest), goose and pork confit. Head cheese: fromage de tête, Sülze, brawn, Presskopf.

Tier shelf. Keep market-covering brands only (SPAM/Hormel, Tulip, Libby's, Exeter, Hereford for tinned; supermarket own-label for cooked). Merge the three mixed-pack catch-alls into one selection kind.

k.brief: Types: roast beef, roast turkey, roast pork; porchetta stays a model.
Types: cured selection, sausage selection, cooked deli platter.

depts.note: Less common meats by animal; horse cuts merged into one kind.

s.brief: Horse meat: merge all horse cuts into one kind with types (steak, tenderloin, flank, mince) and basashi (Kumamoto) as archetype. Bison: American bison, plains vs wood; types steak, mince. Add sourced kinds for kangaroo (Australia), ostrich, crocodile & alligator, camel. Frogs' legs, edible insects (crickets, mealworms; EU novel-food approved species as types), turtle meat stay kind-level. Meat box: the mixed fresh-meat pack becomes the butcher's box/subscription box kind.

k.brief: Mixed raw meat packs and butcher's boxes; no models.
